verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an exit path. OCI exposes everything through standard REST APIs, a CLI with full Console parity, SDKs, a Terraform provider (portable infrastructure definitions) and object storage, so data and configuration can in principle be pulled out programmatically. Nothing documents a dedicated export or exit capability, and the import-oriented items (CSV user import, Terraform state import) don't speak to leaving. missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account data export, explicit open-format export guarantees, documented egress or migration-out path, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.
